author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt:
Build a multi-agent coordination system where each worker (Claude CLI session) has:
1. Their own root GOAL node - each session starts with a goal
2. Hierarchical tree view - expandable tree showing TYPE, CONF, ID, TITLE columns
3. Nodeset sharing via PubSub - coders receive lead's nodeset on startup
4. Conflict detection - workers check for overlaps in modules/functions/tests before acting

title: Multi-Agent Coordination with Hierarchical Decision Trees
